verdict.rationale: The SDK lets developers react to events in code. sandbox.watch() uses native inotify with include filters and an onEvent callback, which supports hot-reload and responsive file processing. Workers can also intercept outbound HTTP from sandboxes. However, these are programmatic callbacks a developer must write, not user-definable automation rules, and they cover only filesystem and outbound-request events. Missing for 10: a declarative rule or trigger configuration, event sources beyond filesystem and outbound HTTP (e.g. lifecycle, schedule or webhook triggers), and documented rule-to-action workflows with independent corroboration.
